svg.title: Airline System architecture
svg.desc: React and a JWT API gateway access nine Spring Boot business services. Eureka and Config Server provide shared infrastructure. Kafka links flight, payment, booking, seat and notification events. Nine services own MySQL databases, four services cache with Redis, payment integrates Stripe, and notification sends email via MailHog.
svg.text: React → API Gateway → Spring Boot services → MySQL · Redis · Kafka
Shared infrastructure: discovery and configuration for gateway + services
OpenFeign REST: Flight and Booking coordinate identity and reference services
One database per business service · Spring Data JPA
Solid arrows: REST / data · Purple arrows: Kafka events · Dashed arrows: shared infrastructure dependencies
